title: Contiguous United States county boundaries with ACS 2017–2021 5-year Economic Distress Index input variables
geographic_coverage: 48 contiguous states plus District of Columbia; Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico excluded.

acs_source.dataset: ACS 2017–2021 5-Year Estimates, Detailed Tables; table-based summary files
acs_source.units: ACS estimate counts; derived fields are proportions (0–1)

notes: Raw ACS estimate fields are retained for reproducibility.
Division by zero yields missing derived values.

The referenced Economic Distress Index notebook identifies these six domains but displays directionally inconsistent education/unemployment formulas; this package uses label-consistent formulas and preserves raw inputs.
